slides.label: For club leads
slides.title: Run your college club from *one place.*
slides.lede: Your Space and your team, set up in 10 minutes.

slides.title: Create your Space
slides.text: Name, link, a line about your club. Every event and member lives here.

slides.title: Add your members
slides.text: Bring in the core team. Everyone joins with their own account.

slides.title: Decide who can do what
slides.text: Curator, Co-Curator, Crew. Tick what each role can touch.

slides.title: Give each event a team
slides.text: Pick people from your Space and set their role for that event.

slides.title: Set up your Space *tonight.*
slides.lede: Free for RSVP events. Next year's team takes over the same Space.
